sentences.en: Sami crossed the road and got to the other curb.
sentences.zh: 萨米横过马路，来到对面的路缘。

sentences.en: He just uses women and kicks them to the curb.
sentences.zh: 他只是利用女性，然后把她们一脚踢开。

sentences.en: Please give me some kind of medicine to curb the pain.
sentences.zh: 请给我一些止痛药来抑制疼痛。

senses.zh: 控制，抑制；<美>路缘，马路牙子；（马的跗关节后部因扭伤韧带引起的）硬瘤

mnemonic: 词根记忆：cur（跑）+b→沿路跑→路缘
